items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Me, Donald and Terrence were roommates.

ctx.x: Yeah, I knew Duff. We went to high school together and he went to Southern when I went to Southern. And then I went to Berkeley and he followed me to Berklee. So, yeah, I knew Donald. So, Donald and there was a guy named Terrence Manual, a piano player and that was our first…. Me, Donald and Terrence were roommates. And then we went to another room and it was me, Donald, and Smitty were roommates – room 401. Yeah, New Orleans is one of them places where all the guys in that generation, they kinda know each other.
And who else? Are there any other drummers who are of note, or…that might bear mentioning.
